com.colonist_thieves.building.hideout.de: A back room with a board on the wall. Pin a Mark to it and the thief on shift takes the job: out over the wall after dark, and home before the town wakes up - clean, seen, or not at all.
colonist_thieves:thief.job.desc: Slips out at night to rob somewhere you have marked - a raider camp, a village, a temple, a kingdom, a neighbour's town - and comes home with whatever he could carry. Some nights he comes home with nothing but a limp.
colonist_thieves:thief.skills.desc: Agility is the craft: getting in, getting out, and not being where the torch is. Adaptability is what is left when the plan was wrong.
item.colonist_thieves.mark.desc: Use it on somewhere worth robbing, then on a Hideout to pin it to the board.
com.colonist_thieves.chat.blocked: I can't get out of the Hideout! Is the way blocked?
com.minecolonies.coremod.jei.thief: Robs other people's settlements. Craft a Mark, use it on somewhere worth robbing, and hand it in at the Hideout.
com.colonist_thieves.gui.board.title: The board
com.colonist_thieves.gui.board.nomarks: Nothing pinned. Use a Mark on somewhere worth robbing, then hand it in here.
com.colonist_thieves.gui.ledger.title: The log
com.colonist_thieves.research.technology: Somebody has to know how a lock comes apart.
A door is only a suggestion.
There is no lock left that he has not seen the inside of.
Knowing what sells is half of stealing it.
com.colonist_thieves.research.effects.fe: Thieves bring home what a Hideout %1$s levels higher would
com.colonist_thieves.research.technology: The trick is not getting away. It is not being looked for.
com.colonist_thieves.research.effects.co: A robbed place gets %3$s%% less nervous
com.colonist_thieves.research.technology: He was at the tavern all night. Four people say so.
com.colonist_thieves.research.effects.al: A thief who is seen costs %3$s%% less standing
com.colonist_thieves.research.technology: Nobody watches the road nobody uses.
Out one night and back the same one.
com.colonist_thieves.gui.sightings.title: Somewhere to rob
com.colonist_thieves.gui.sightings.empty: Nothing but your own town. Press Look around, and give it a moment.
com.colonist_thieves.gui.sightings.gone: There is nothing there any more.
com.colonist_thieves.gui.sightings.unrea: nobody has looked at it yet
